source.authority: U.S. Department of Energy / National Nuclear Security Administration Nevada Field Office
source.document: United States Nuclear Tests, July 1945 through September 1992

paper_binding.paper: Bruehl et al., Scientific Reports 2026, DOI 10.1038/s41598-026-66148-2
paper_binding.paper_method_statement: Dates of all U.S. above ground nuclear tests during 1949-11-19 through 1957-04-28 were obtained from DOE/NV-209 Rev.16; nuclear window is test date +/-1 day.
paper_binding.not_claimed: This is not claimed to be byte-identical to an unpublished author-side date file because that exact file has not been acquired.

selection_rule_frozen_before_harmonized_.include_country: United States only, because that is the 2026 ML paper method statement.
selection_rule_frozen_before_harmonized_.include_date_range: DOE test date inside the POSS-I study window.
selection_rule_frozen_before_harmonized_.surface_safety_experiments: INCLUDED in the primary literal arm because DOE lists them as tests and their physical type is Surface. This choice is frozen before observing a harmonized outcome.
selection_rule_frozen_before_harmonized_.deduplication: Multiple DOE tests on one GMT date become one exposure date while all event identities remain nested in that JSONL record.

predeclared_sensitivity_arm.reason: The phrase 'nuclear weapons tests' may be interpreted as excluding DOE rows whose purpose is Safety Experiment. This ambiguity is declared now rather than after seeing the result.
predeclared_sensitivity_arm.rule: Remove DOE test IDs 65, 66, 67, 68, and 86 only; retain all other primary-arm dates.

epistemic_guard: The official DOE table is a source-bound nuclear-test chronology, not evidence for a POSS-I association.
The manifest was frozen before the harmonized closed/open effect was available.
A difference between this 74-date reconstruction and an author-side manifest must be treated as a provenance discrepancy, not silently edited to improve significance.
The +/-1 nuclear window is applied by the harmonization runner; it is not expanded or shifted after seeing candidate data.
